result.summary: Found 1 significant visual issue: overlapping restaurant metadata makes part of the listing difficult to read.

issues.description: The delivery-time and delivery-fee text beneath “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” overlap each other, creating a garbled line before the “Ramen” label.
issues.suggestion: Place each metadata item in a properly spaced flex row, prevent negative spacing, and add wrapping or truncation rules for narrower screens.
